data.narrative:
Colossal Biosciences, a Series C biotech company founded by Ben Lamm and George Church, has raised $555M+ and carries a current post-money valuation of $10.3B. Valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in the Biotech & Health sector, including same-stage comparables Chai Discovery ($3.8B) and New Limit ($3.1B).

Two triangulation methods prove applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier to the $10.3B base, implying $17.5B. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies yields $3.1B, with the private comp range spanning $539M to $3.8B. Public-comp anchoring using sector P/S multiples (5.6x median across the three public tickers) cannot be applied due to absence of disclosed revenue figures.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $2.6B (low) to $20.2B (high), with a median of $10.3B anchored to the current post-money. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around stage-progression expectations versus peer trading patterns. Key drivers of range sensitivity include whether the company commands premium multiples relative to same-stage biotech comparables and the timing and dilution profile of subsequent funding rounds.
